items.text: Colts HC Shane Steichen ruled out TE Tyler Warren (groin) for Sunday vs Vikings along with CB Sauce Gardner (calf).
items.why: Groin injury; missed practice and ruled out by coach for Week 7.
items.implication: Colts TE targets redistribute; WR usage (Downs/Allen/Pierce) or other TEs elevate short-term.
items.opportunity: Higher target share for Josh Downs, Alec Pierce or backup TEs in IND offense.

items.text: Bears TE Cole Kmet believed to have suffered a serious, likely season-ending knee injury after non-contact buckle and cart-off vs Patriots; undergoing tests with no finality yet. Coach Ben Johnson said it did not look very good.
items.why: Non-contact knee injury carted off late TNF; sources and coach comments indicate serious damage pending final tests.
items.implication: Bears TE usage shifts heavily to backups for ROS; reduces 2/3 TE sets.
items.opportunity: Increased routes/snaps for Colston Loveland and Luther Burden; higher target share potential in CHI passing game.

items.text: Rams WR Puka Nacua suffered what is believed to be a minor calf injury after exiting Thursday practice; status up in the air for Sunday vs Raiders after tests. Not significant but not nothing.
items.why: Left practice early Thursday with calf; tests show minor, but availability for Week 7 unclear given late timing and Adams already out.
items.implication: If out, Rams WR depth thin with Adams on IR; heavy TE reliance possible. If in, massive target volume expected.
items.opportunity: If OUT: Konata Mumpfield or TEs (Higbee/Parkinson) rise; if ACTIVE: 25+ tgt pace with Adams gone.

items.text: Lamar Jackson came out onto the field for Friday's practice, an encouraging sign after limited sessions and missing prior games with left ankle injury. Ravens host Bengals Sunday.
items.why: Spotted practicing Friday after two limited days; positive trajectory post multi-game absence.
items.implication: Likely return boosts BAL offense and fantasy ceiling vs CIN; reduces Huntley stream value.
items.opportunity: Full snaps/rushes if cleared; Flowers/Henry/Andrews benefit from elite QB play.

items.text: The more I watch Jaylen Warren, the more I love his game. The Steelers have something special. Loves him @ NO (RB9) for big workload in friendly matchup.
items.why: Impressed by film/game; big workload expected vs Saints defense carved by RBs.
items.implication: RB2/flex with upside; start confidently in Week 7.
items.opportunity: Featured role/carries in positive game script matchup.

items.text: TreVeyon Henderson has played on just 21% of the snaps over the last three weeks. Not like this.
items.why: Persistently low snap share last 3 weeks despite prior hype; committee or scheme limiting role.
items.implication: Hard to trust as weekly starter; Stevenson or others may hold primary NE RB work.
items.opportunity: Low snap share limits carries/routes; monitor for any role expansion but currently buried.

items.text: Luther Burden has only run 68.8% of the routes this season but is ripping elite 2.56 yards per route run. Cole Kmet injury may reduce 2- and 3-TE sets, giving Burden even more juice.
items.why: Elite YPRR on limited routes; Kmet likely SE opens more 11 personnel and WR opportunities.
items.implication: Burden becomes higher-upside WR flex/ROS stash in CHI with expanded role potential.
items.opportunity: Route rate expansion beyond 68.8%; more targets/snaps with Kmet out and Loveland also rising.

items.text: Saquon Barkley is back for Week 7 vs DAL. Efficient in two full games played; Dallas strong fantasy matchup for RBs. Viewing as mid-range RB2 with RB1 upside but re-injury risk.
items.why: Cleared/in-line to play; prior efficiency + elite matchup vs Cowboys RB-friendly defense.
items.implication: Start as RB2 with upside; monitor workload ramp and any setbacks.
items.opportunity: Featured carries/routes expected; handcuffs lose value if full go.

items.text: Loves A.J. Brown @ CHI (WR10). Buying after Week 6: 3 catches/3 drops on 10 targets/27 yards but 33% target share and 97% routes. Bears defense good for yardage.
items.why: Elite route/target share despite drops; matchup vs CHI secondary and volume floor.
items.implication: Strong WR2/flex start with bounce-back potential; buy-low opportunity.
items.opportunity: High route % and target share sustain; Bears allow yardage.

items.text: 10 Facts: C.J. Stroud 6th-best QB last 3 weeks (QB1 upside). Bo Nix 5.4 aDOT (no viable Broncos WRs). Ashton Jeanty inefficient (<3 YPC 4/5), Mike Washington season-high 33% snaps/near-equal rushes—possible bigger role.
items.why: Usage/efficiency trends and scheme limits; Stroud volume, Nix short throws, Jeanty/Washington split evolving.
items.implication: Start Stroud confidently; fade Nix/Broncos pass-catchers; monitor Jeanty handcuff Washington.
items.opportunity: Washington snap/rush share rising if Jeanty stays inefficient; Nix aDOT caps WR upside.

items.text: Josh Jacobs was allowed in team meetings, lifting, medical treatments and non-football activities at facility. MarShawn Lloyd (49th EPA/rush) and Kaleb Johnson (53rd) have been quite bad amid OL mess. Discussed long-term outlook on ROS Top-150 show.
items.why: Facility access positive for return timeline; backups inefficient EPA/rush supporting Jacobs value when back.
items.implication: ROS outlook solidifies as GB RB1 once cleared; handcuff Lloyd/Johnson unappealing.
items.opportunity: Potential full workload return; poor backup efficiency creates clear path.

items.text: Loves Chuba Hubbard vs TB (RB10) and Bucky Irving @ CAR (RB12) for big workloads in friendly matchups. Hubbard consistent; Irving gets defense carved by RBs.
items.why: Volume + matchup: defenses allowing high RB fantasy points; consistent roles.
items.implication: Solid RB2 starts with floor/ceiling in Week 7.
items.opportunity: High snap/carry shares expected in positive spots.

items.text: Hates Rome Odunze vs NE (WR32), Josh Downs @ MIN (WR41), Travis Kelce @ SEA (TE9). Nasty matchups and suboptimal roles/target shares.
items.why: Tough defenses for Odunze/Kelce; Downs low target share on low-scoring offense.
items.implication: Sit/fade in Week 7 lineups despite name value.
items.opportunity: Suppressed routes/targets expected vs elite or stingy units.

items.text: Hates Josh Jacobs @ DET (RB18) and Cam Skattebo @ HOU (RB37). Jacobs workload questions after long layoff; Skattebo brutal spot.
items.why: Post-layoff uncertainty for Jacobs; tough matchup/role for Skattebo.
items.implication: Avoid starts; prefer other options despite name/volume potential.
items.opportunity: Limited or inefficient work likely short-term.
items.conflict: Levitan more positive on Jacobs facility/ROS path.
